data.text: **Question:** Your team needs to add a new feature that breaks an existing API contract. What do you do?
Use API versioning to maintain backward compatibility. Deprecate old versions gradually. Communicate changes to consumers. Provide migration path.
API versioning strategies: URL path, query string, header. Deprecate old versions with warnings. Document changes clearly. Provide migration guides. Use feature flags for gradual rollout.
